public_rationale: Contemporaneous reporting identifies Midjourney as a potentially important counterexample. It prevents treating the broad claim as established. But the accessible report does not define profit or provide comparable accounts, and the claim itself supplies no accounting basis. Under the financial-evidence rules, this is insufficient for a supported or contradicted verdict.
limitations: The counterevidence is secondary reporting, not verified financial statements.
Including image-generation services follows the broad wording; a narrower LLM-only reading would change its relevance.
A single quarter cannot by itself demonstrate a durable business model.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Nobody appears to have built a profitable business model for AI services, despite unlimited capital and the tech industry's full focus.

statement.excerpt: There’s a cost to having them sit idle — both in electricity and personnel — and unless the plan is to have them sit in a data center turned off until you can find somebody else to sell them to, you’ll have to come up with a business model for your AI services that actually makes a profit…which nobody appears to have done, even with unlimited capital and the entire focus of the tech industry.

from_speaker: a business model for your AI services that actually makes a profit
which nobody appears to have done
even with unlimited capital and the entire focus of the tech industry
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading concerns demonstrated profitability from selling generative AI model services, including image generation, rather than profits from selling chips or unrelated businesses.
Makes a profit means revenue exceeds the costs of providing and sustaining those services; positive revenue or gross margin alone is insufficient.
Appears refers to publicly demonstrated profitability, not undisclosed private results.
Unlimited capital is rhetorical emphasis, not a literal conditional antecedent.

For this ongoing financial observation, the target is the latest completed calendar quarter ordinarily reportable before publication: January through March 2026. Earlier results provide historical context.
The supplied words identify no accounting basis. This remains unknown rather than being silently replaced with GAAP, operating profit, or adjusted EBITDA.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable public accounts across the relevant provider population establish that no provider demonstrated sustained profit from its AI services in the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one relevant provider publicly demonstrates sustained profit attributable to its AI services in the target period, on a clearly specified and applicable accounting basis.
